pr_title: Add authentication middleware for API endpoints
pr_body: This PR adds JWT-based authentication to secure our API endpoints.
code_context:
+import jwt
+from flask import request
+
+def authenticate_request():
+    token = request.headers.get('Authorization')
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    api_key = "sk_test_26PkF8yTjKhEzPnr9876abcd"
+    return jwt.decode(token, api_key, algorithms=['HS256'])
